steps.title: Rise, Titan.
steps.subtitle: A new desktop. A smarter way to work.
steps.body: Discover what your desktop can do.
steps.prompt: Press Enter or click Explore ArchTitan to begin.

steps.title: Your Desktop
steps.subtitle: A clean, powerful and beautiful workspace.
steps.body: Waybar, Dynamic Workspaces, and Modern Glass UI.
steps.prompt: Click Waybar, Dynamic Workspaces, or Modern Glass UI to inspect.

steps.title: Everything, Instantly
steps.subtitle: Find apps, files, and more with Titan Spotlight.
steps.body: Tap Super to search applications, files, or calculate expressions instantly.
steps.prompt: Try searching for an application or typing a math calculation.

steps.title: Your Workspace. Your Flow.
steps.subtitle: Organize your work with Mission Control.
steps.body: Switch between ten workspaces or drag windows across desktops.
steps.prompt: Click a workspace thumbnail or press Super + Tab to open Mission Control.

steps.title: Control Everything
steps.subtitle: Manage connectivity, sound, brightness and more from one place.
steps.body: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, PipeWire audio, brightness, power profile, DND and notifications.
steps.prompt: Try toggling a control or adjusting a slider.

steps.title: Always in the Loop
steps.subtitle: Enjoy a sleek media HUD with real-time controls.
steps.body: Dynamic Island MPRIS media controls and contextual system capsule.
steps.prompt: Press Super + M or click the media capsule to toggle the live HUD.

steps.title: Intelligence Under the Hood
steps.subtitle: THM intelligently manages resources for smooth performance.
steps.body: Real-time CPU, RAM, thermal and PSI workload orchestration at 5 Hz.
steps.prompt: Click the telemetry card or dwell on the left screen edge to open Sysmon.

steps.title: Protection by Design
steps.subtitle: Stay safe with Titan Sandbox, ArchTitan Guard and snapshots.
steps.body: Namespace application isolation, display manager protection, and bootable BTRFS snapshots.
steps.prompt: Protected automatically out of the box.

steps.title: Make It Yours
steps.subtitle: Customize your experience with themes, wallpapers and more.
steps.body: Preview themes and bespoke wallpapers safely.
steps.prompt: Click any accent swatch or floating wallpaper card to preview.

steps.title: You're Ready
steps.subtitle: Your workspace. Your rules. Your Titan.
steps.body: Enter ArchTitan or explore features again anytime with Super + F1.
